text: Staff from the Housing Secretariat and Housing Development Office will give a presentation on the Toronto Builds Policy Framework and Implementation adopted by City Council in May and July, 2025, to activate City land to build more affordable homes.

The Board of Directors of CreateTO: 1. Received the presentation from the Executive Director, Housing Development Office, Deputy City Manager's Office, Development and Growth Services and the Project Director, Housing Policy and Strategy, Housing Secretariat for information.
